simple.meaning: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume ; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כָּרַת (H3772) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 290 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כָּרַת (kârath) means to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume ; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 3.
